scientific_integrity: Analytical fourth-cumulant proof and independent polynomial-generator numerical cross-checks; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Stationary independent Ornstein–Uhlenbeck relative coordinate and either an independent Gaussian OU or symmetric Poisson telegraph force with matched stationary two-time covariance; no repulsion.
The result applies to center-of-mass displacement cumulants, not stationary center-of-mass positions or finite-sample statistical efficiency.
Publication priority against inaccessible or more general literature is not independently established.
title: Fourth-cumulant separation of covariance-matched active dimers
